# Flock

![Flock](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/flock.png)

+10% Heads for every other Flock in your bank.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 40%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 4 points

## Tails
Nothing
